g.text: is a short story by Terry Pratchett, written in 1998. It is set in his
witches Granny Weatherwax and Nanny Ogg. It was originally published in a sampler alongside a story called "The Wood Boy" by Raymond E. Feist,
and later in a collection called
The story established a basis for various elements of the novel
, but is not required to understand that novel.
